profile: Electrical engineering student with practical experience building and debugging digital systems, Linux kernel components, and accelerated computing pipelines. Developed and validated timing-sensitive interfaces and concurrent workflows using verified project evidence.

bullets: Relevant coursework: Digital Systems Design, Computer Architecture, Operating Systems, Accelerated Systems, Data Structures and Algorithms, and Computer Vision.

projects.title: Digital System Implementation
bullets: Designed and implemented a modular system with timing-sensitive interfaces, bounded packet handling, and an integrated debugging workflow.
Built and validated concurrent components using synchronization primitives, shared memory, and coordinated producer-consumer execution.
Investigated integration failures and verified system behavior through repeatable debugging, synthesis iteration, and memory-management analysis.
